### Modifications / 改动内容

<!--
概述改动：修改了哪些核心文件？实现了什么功能？
Summarize the change: which core files were touched, what was implemented?
-->

### Type of change / 变更类型

<!-- 勾选适用项。Check all that apply. -->
- [ ] `feat` new feature / 新功能
- [ ] `fix` bug fix / 缺陷修复
- [ ] `refactor` code refactor / 重构
- [ ] `docs` documentation / 文档
- [ ] `test` tests / 测试
- [ ] `chore` / `ci` build, deps, CI / 构建、依赖、CI

### Verification Steps / 验证步骤

<!--
说明如何验证本次改动有效（命令、操作路径等）。
Explain how the change was verified (commands, steps, etc.).
例如 / e.g. `python -m pytest -m "not slow"`
-->
- [ ] Tests pass locally / 本地测试通过
- [ ] Manually verified / 已手动验证

### Screenshots or Logs / 截图或日志

<!--
涉及 UI、可视化或行为变化时，粘贴截图 / GIF / 日志作为证据。
For UI, visualization, or behavior changes, paste screenshots/GIFs/logs as evidence.
-->

### Related issues / 关联 Issue

<!-- 例如 Closes #123；没有可留空。 -->
<!-- e.g. Closes #123; leave blank if none. -->

### Checklist / 检查清单

<!--
若合并，你的代码将服务众多用户，请在提交前仔细核对。
If merged, your code will serve many users. Please double-check before submitting.
-->

- [ ] This is **NOT** a breaking change. / 这不是一项破坏性变更。
      <!-- 若为破坏性变更，请取消上面的勾选，并在描述中明确说明。 -->
      <!-- If it is a breaking change, uncheck the box above and clearly note it in the description. -->
- [ ] New features have been discussed with the maintainers via issues/emails. / 新增功能已通过 Issue/邮件与维护者讨论。
- [ ] My changes are well tested, and "Verification Steps" and "Screenshots" are provided above. / 改动已充分测试，并在上方提供了验证步骤与截图。
- [ ] No new dependencies, or any added dependency is recorded in `requirements.txt`. / 未引入新依赖，或已将其写入 `requirements.txt`。
- [ ] Docs updated if needed. / 必要时已更新文档。
- [ ] My changes do not introduce malicious code. / 改动不包含恶意代码。
